Game Overview

The Fly puts players into a arcade experience centered on defend your domain against relentless insect swarms in The Fly. With a trusty spray canister and limited time, strategically aim and unleash deadly toxins. Navigate challenging levels, master precise clicking, and stay composed under pressure to progress. This exhilarating battle of strategy and reflexes will keep you buzzing.
